title: Add key on Email Message Attachment Data to speed up email deletion (backport to releases/29.x)
summary: A database key was added to the Data field of the Email Message Attachment table to improve performance when deleting emails, avoiding full table scans on large tenants.
key_points: Added index on Email Message Attachment.Data field
Speeds up email deletion operations by eliminating full table scans
Particularly benefits agents like Payables Agent during storage cleanup
Same indexing pattern applied to Document Attachment Media field
Backport to BC29 of existing BC30 change
